{{Top|canon=Vehicle commander}}
'''AT-AT commanders''' were [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] who were placed in command of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]]. AT-AT commanders served as the leader of the command crew of an AT-AT, overseeing the [[Vehicle Command Crewer|pilot]] and [[Imperial gunner/Legends|gunner]].<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> Commanders used the vehicle's [[electrorangefinder]] to accurately direct the [[Walker/Legends|walker's]] weapons fire.<ref name="CCG-Electro-Rangefinder">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Electro-Rangefinder}}</ref>
